trace.question: For patients with severe degree of thrombosis, list their ID, sex and disease the patient is diagnosed with.
trace.evidence: severe degree of thrombosis refers to thrombosis = 2; disease refers to diagnosis;

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, E.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, E.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
trace.answer: Three patients have severe thrombosis: patient 163109 (female, no diagnosis recorded), patient 2803470 (female, diagnosed with SLE and psychosis), and patient 4395720 (female, diagnosed with SLE).
